notes: CurbToken is src/CurbToken.sol: Curb (CURB), 18 decimals, no constructor arguments. Its constructor mints the fixed 1,000,000,000-token supply once to its deployer; it exposes no owner, further mint, burn, tax or pause. CurbHook is src/CurbHook.sol, using the vendored OpenZeppelin uniswap-hooks BaseHook, identified in the repository as v1.3.0-rc.0. Constructor arguments follow the declaration: poolManager_, token_, initializer_, owner_, bandTicks, edgeTicks, refWindow, limitSeconds, haltSeconds, cooldownSeconds, minLiquidityE18, arbBlocks. The seven numeric settings are 1000, 100, 300, 15, 900, 1800 and 100000; durations are seconds and minLiquidityE18 scales to 1e23 in-range liquidity. arbBlocks is true, encoded as the ABI word 1. Deploy with CREATE2 mining for flags 0x20C0, exactly beforeInitialize, beforeSwap and afterSwap. BaseHook restricts all callbacks to the PoolManager. Initialization is allowed once, only with sender $factory, a key containing $token, static fee 12500 and tick spacing 60. This manifest selects CURB/IMD on Robinhood Chain. The hook takes no additional fee, returns zero deltas and enables no liquidity or donation callbacks; adding, removing and the factory's zero-liquidity fee collect are untouched. The pool charges the specified 1.25% LP fee. Outside a halt, the band check rejects a swap ending more than 1000 ticks from the time-weighted reference and farther from it than the starting tick; moves toward the reference pass that check. The 300-second reference window rolls lazily on swaps, with clamping to keep the current tick out of the edge zone. Remaining in the 100-tick edge zone for 15 seconds triggers a halt in both directions for at most 900 seconds, followed by a 1800-second cooldown measured from the scheduled halt end. Below the liquidity floor, the hook does not start the edge clock or roll the reference. A swap starting below that floor may be admitted within 1000 ticks of the first qualifying liquidity boundary it crosses, reanchoring the reference. The immutable owner is $owner, the CurbDesk contract paying for this launch. Its sole hook authority, resolve(nonce, verdict), may end an active halt early or pin the pre-move reference through cooldown, with clamping on reopen; it cannot extend a halt, change parameters, transfer ownership or move funds. CurbDesk in desk/CurbDesk.sol is deployed separately from the steward's wallet, outside src/, and is not deployed by this manifest. pool.initialPrice is the required one-to-one sqrtPriceX96; deployment derives the actual opening price from the separate launch policy and token ordering. docs/VERIFICATION.md records a Robinhood fork rehearsal of LaunchFactory.launch with this token, hook and constructor settings in both token orders, including swaps, band refusal, fee collection, halt and oracle verdict delivery. This assignment leaves the production source unchanged for the relaunch of #2255. Local offline checks passed: forge build; forge test with the assignment's fuzz seed (188 passed, 0 failed, 2 fork tests skipped without RH_RPC); script/protected.sh below and above (13 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped per token order).
